--ams-avatar-font-weight: Defined with the component in #1134 but never wired up; avatar.scss sets every other typography property. Wire it up or remove it in a major release.
--ams-avatar-forced-colors-border-width: Consumed until #1998 replaced the border with a box shadow. Removing it is a breaking change, so it waits for a major release.
--ams-field-gap: Deprecated in favour of the ams.field-set.child.* tokens, and no longer referenced since #2358. Its removal date has passed, so it goes in the next major release.
--ams-field-set-legend-margin-block-end: Deprecated in favour of the ams.field-set.child.* tokens, and no longer referenced since #2358. Its removal date has passed, so it goes in the next major release.
--ams-file-input-file-selector-button-di: Wired up by #2813, which styles the disabled file selector button. Remove this entry once that lands.
--ams-page-header-menu-item-font-family: Redundant since page-header.scss sets the font family on the root, which the menu items inherit. Removing it is a breaking change, so it waits for a major release.
--ams-search-field-input-cancel-button-c: Never referenced in the history of search-field.scss. The cancel button is drawn as a data URI with its colour baked into the SVG, so this token cannot take effect without reworking how it is drawn.
